sermons.title: Sermon 3547 | Simple Fact and Simple Faith

scripture.verse: Be it known unto you, therefore, men and brethren, that through this Man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins and by Him all that believe are justified from all things from which they could not be justified by the Law of Moses.

sermons.title: Sermon 3548 | The Saint's Trials and the Divine Deliverances

scripture.verse: I cried unto God ... You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
Fear not, little flock, for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
Kiss the Son lest He be angry, and you perish from the way, when His wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in Him.
For our Gospel came not unto you in word only ... from the wrath to come"
My beloved had withdrawn himself, and was gone.

sermons.title: Sermon 3553 | The Fullness and the Filling

scripture.verse: And ofHis fullness have we all received, and Grace for Grace
He shall see of the travail of His soul, and be satisfied. By His knowledge shall My righteous Servant justify many, for He shall bear their iniquities.
He was girded about the chest with a golden band.
